name: @pipeworx/mcp-gwas-catalog

tools.name: get_snp
tools.description: GWAS Catalog: look up a single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) by rsID. Returns functional class, chromosome/region locations, and mapped genes (with up/downstream + distance). Keyless, from EBI/NHGRI.

tools.name: snp_associations
tools.description: GWAS Catalog: get trait/disease associations for a SNP (rsID) — risk allele, p-value, odds ratio per copy, beta/effect size, and risk allele frequency. Keyless, from EBI/NHGRI.

tools.name: studies_by_trait
tools.description: GWAS Catalog: find genome-wide association studies for a disease/trait (EFO trait, e.g. "asthma" or "type 2 diabetes"). Returns accession, PubMed ID, title, journal, date, sample size. Keyless, from EBI/NHGRI.

trait.description: Disease or trait name, e.g. "asthma", "type 2 diabetes".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gwas-catalog forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gwas-catalog pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
